system.description:
This vehicle alarm triggers whenever an attempt is made to break into the vehicle (for example, by smashing a window or bypassing a door lock), unless the intruder succeeds at a @Check[skill:disableDevice|dc:30]{Disable Device check (DC 30)}.

When activated, the paralytic alarm emits a hypnotic pulse that paralyzes any creature within 30 feet for 2d6 rounds. A successful @Check[save:will|dc:15]{Will save (DC 15)} negates this mind-affecting enchantment.
